<!-- pr-reviewer: 68e8ffbfd9cc7b29ebcc00d4971e21a5369d78da -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

## What looks good
- Single derivation: `setup::wcs_slot` (setup.rs:109) is still the only reader of the stored pick; `setup_offsets::index` (setup_offsets.rs:38) is `wcs_slot + 1` with saturating/try_from, no clamp. `posting::wcs_context` (posting.rs:1102) returns that index. `WCS_SLOTS` has no remaining use in `crates/` (now crate-private `LEGACY_WCS_NAMES`).
- No fallback to offset 1: `setup::work_offset` returns the stored pick unfiltered; names (`work_offset_names`) are display only and never feed the stream. An unreadable post shows the legacy table but `check` refuses offsets above 6 by name.
- Out-of-range is refused by name, not clamped: `setup_offsets::range_problems` is in `verification_report_by` (posting.rs:762), which the single-file, per-mount (posting_mounts.rs:221/223) and per-op (posting_per_op.rs:153) posts all use; `SetSetupWorkOffset::new` calls `check`; the loader refuses a corrupt pick text (apply.rs:812) and bounds the pick to 0..=254.
- Agrees with main's #1101: the engine still runs `Manifest::translate` as the only number-to-word step (engine.rs:162-170) and refuses by name with a warning; this PR only supplies the index.
- Merge commit 68e8ffbf: `git show --remerge-diff` touches exactly one file, `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`, and only the `sel` re-export lines (PR form kept, no `WCS_SLOTS`). Nothing else hand-edited. No golden, snapshot, PROCESS_VERSION, CHANGELOG or build-surface file in the diff.
- Format: offsets 1-6 still save as G54..G59 (round-trip byte-identical), 7+ as number; decision file `docs/decisions/931-wcs-index-app.md` records the break for old builds.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43536767136 (success; main 745edc36 trial-merged). Quick gate on the merged tree: post suites ok, app suites ok, app probe_no_coolant (1 fn) ok, ui suites ok, 4 steps, 0 failed (18.1 min wall). Clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings: clean. Not run locally (no cfg(windows) lines in the change).

## Requested before merge
None from the code read.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Body states: held for the PathPilot Hub run, now recorded PASS (2026-11-13, user, on #1124's head which contains this slice); a user `.cps` with extended offsets not hand-tried. Merges after #1101 (merged). Draft state is now ready (isDraft false); the earlier "back to draft until Hub run" comment is satisfied by that result.
- Breaking for old builds opening offset 7+ files: ensure the release notes say so (decision file covers it); the commit type is `feat`, not marked breaking - confirm intended.
- Not exercised by me: GUI, Windows-only arms (no cfg(windows) lines seen in the touched areas), release-lane suites.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
